Considering that the matter relates to the offence under Section 376 IPC, the IO shall inform the complainant about her right to free legal aid/representation in accordance with the decision of the Supreme Court in Jagjeet Singh v. Ashish Mishra, reported as (2022) 9 SCC 321 and if required,
shall assist the prosecutrix in approaching the Member Secretary, Delhi High Court Legal Services Committee who may appoint a panel counsel, if so requested.

The IO is directed to facilitate the victim in approaching the Member Secretary, DSLSA and ensure that subject to completion of formalities, the awarded amount be released to the victim at
This is a digitally signed order.

The appellant is directed to be served through concerned SHO for the next date of hearing.
4. Renotify on 04.11.2025.
